text: # Product Troubleshooting Guide ## Login Issues If a customer can't log in, first confirm they're using the email address their account was created with. A password reset link is sent from the login page's "Forgot password" link and expires after 30 minutes. Repeated failed logins lock the account for 15 minutes as a security measure. ## Sync Delays Data syncs across devices every 5 minutes by default. If a customer reports a sync delay longer than 15 minutes, ask them to check their device's network connection and confirm the app is on the latest version — sync reliability issues are almost always fixed by updating. ## Export Errors CSV exports larger than 50,000 rows are processed in the background and emailed to the account owner when ready, rather than downloading directly in the browser. This can take up to 20 minutes for very large exports. ## API Rate Limits The REST API allows 600 requests per minute per API key. Requests over the limit receive a 429 response with a `Retry-After` header. Customers hitting limits regularly should batch requests or ask about the higher-throughput Team plan tier.
